gaps.lead: Living in the city is new to her.
gaps.sentence: She is not ___ in the city.
gaps.explanation: 'Be used to living' = be accustomed to (note the gerund).

gaps.lead: He no longer thinks he can find a job before the end of the year.
gaps.sentence: He has given ___ a job before the end of the year.
gaps.explanation: 'No longer thinks he can find' becomes 'has given up hope of finding'.

gaps.lead: Delia said that she would no longer tolerate her colleagues being rude.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action continuing from a past point to now: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: 'I broke the window,' the boy said.
gaps.sentence: When caught, the boy ___ the window.
gaps.explanation: admit + -ing, or admit having + past participle for the earlier action.
